name: Hardpoint Connector Body
description: A hardpoint body will connect to a hardpoint attachment when correctly aligned, fixing the two components in place while transferring logic and fluid. The hardpoint body can release the connection by receiving an on/off input signal.
shortDescription: A hardpoint connector for building detachable vehicle sections.

logicNodes.label: Release
logicNodes.description: Release the connector when receiving an on signal.

logicNodes.label: Launch
logicNodes.description: Release the connector and activate the ordinance when receiving an on signal.

logicNodes.label: Ordinance Type
logicNodes.description: Returns the ordinance type of the attached object.

logicNodes.label: Fluid
logicNodes.description: Fluid connection to link to another fluid connector.

logicNodes.label: Composite Data Send
logicNodes.description: Composite data to send to the connected connector.

logicNodes.label: Composite Data Receive
logicNodes.description: Composite data to receive from the connected connector.

logicNodes.label: Video Data Send
logicNodes.description: Video data to send to the connected connector.

logicNodes.label: Video Data Receive
logicNodes.description: Video data to receive from the connected connector.
